# Домовой Тролль

Use React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Lucide-react. Preserve the VK Desktop Web visual language. Use strict JSON validation for Director and Actor model responses, an asynchronous 2–5 second typing queue, and short colloquial resident messages. Keep static background noise separate from Director and Actor LLM calls.
